channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iranians mark first Ashura since Khamenei’s killing in the US-Iran war
item.description: Thousands gathered in Tehran on the eve of Ashura, the first since the killing of Iranian supreme leader Ali Khamenei.

item.title: Rutte attempts to ease Trump-NATO rift over Iran ahead of annual summit
item.description: NATO chief Mark Rutte visited the White House to ease tensions with Trump ahead of next month's NATO summit.

item.title: Two years on, Kenyan families still seek justice after Gen Z protests
item.description: Families of those killed and missing say investigations have stalled as accountability remains out of reach.

item.title: Trump asks Congress for $87bn, mostly for 'urgent' Iran war costs
item.description: But the budget faces an uphill battle, coming a day after lawmakers rebuked Trump's military action.

item.title: Philippines bans video game played by alleged high school shooter
item.description: The rare school shooting that left three students killed and 20 others injured has shocked the country.

item.title: UN nuclear chief says inspectors will visit Iran sites as part of war deal
item.description: Rafael Grossi says the IAEA is "working on modalities" but an Iranian minister says such access would only be part of a final deal with the US.

item.title: Clean sweep for Mamdani-backed candidates in New York's Democratic primary
item.description: Brad Lander unseats Dan Goldman in a race that laid bare the city's divisions over the Israel-Gaza war.

item.title: Why was JD Vance in a luxury Swiss resort for talks with Iran?
item.description: BBC correspondent Jessica Parker explains some key points of the direct talks between the US vice-president and Iran.
